quickInfo.name: Home Run plunge
quickInfo.summary: The preferred skill shot is the top Home Run lane on the Gottlieb-style playfield.

quickInfo.name: Side hit lanes
quickInfo.summary: The side double and triple lanes provide the default repeatable scoring route into upper bumper action.

quickInfo.name: Base saucers
quickInfo.summary: The first-base, second-base, and third-base saucers each score 1,000 and place a runner on that base.

quickInfo.name: Loaded-base standups
quickInfo.summary: With the bases loaded, the outside Single standups become 5,000-point Home Run targets.

quickInfo.name: Roto-target risk
quickInfo.summary: The top roto-target can award points or a hit result, but its rebound can drain through the center.

quickInfo.name: Edition scope
quickInfo.summary: This route and image cover Gottlieb Grand Slam; World Series is the distinct add-a-ball version.

steps.text: Plunge the top Home Run lane.
From either lower flipper, choose the cleaner side double or triple lane.
Let the lane feed continue into the upper bumpers.
Accept a base saucer only when the ball enters through natural play.
Track the runners after every hit result.
Continue side-lane scoring while the bases are not loaded.
When the bases load, shoot the safer outside Home Run standup for 5,000.
After the runners clear, resume side double and triple lanes.

fallback.title: Natural upper-play route
fallback.when: Use this plan when direct side-lane shots feed the slingshots or outlanes.

steps.text: Stop deliberate side-lane shots.
Send the ball through the broadest upper-playfield opening.
Use natural bumper action for hit results and base-saucer entries.
Avoid the top roto-target face.
Return to a side lane only after its feed becomes controlled.

alternatives.title: Loaded-base conversion
alternatives.when: Use this plan after natural play loads all three bases.

steps.text: Confirm that all three bases show a runner.
Avoid shots that can score another hit before the Home Run attempt.
Choose the safer outside standup above a side lane.
Shoot it for the 5,000-point Home Run.
Use side double and triple lanes for controlled scoring.
Accept natural first-base, second-base, and third-base saucer entries.
Track runner positions after each hit.
Load all three bases.
Collect an outside Home Run standup for 5,000.

techniques.name: Side-lane selection
techniques.instruction: Test both double and triple lanes. Repeat the side whose exit continues cleanly into upper bumper action.

techniques.name: Saucer rim read
techniques.instruction: Track the full rim of every base-saucer attempt. Prepare both flippers before a rejected ball arcs downward.

techniques.name: Loaded-base lamp check
techniques.instruction: Read all three base indicators before changing shots. Use an outside standup only after all bases are occupied.

cautions.issue: Direct base-saucer shots often rim out and send the ball across the playfield without control.
cautions.response: Do not chase the saucers. Let side-lane and bumper action feed them naturally.

cautions.issue: The top roto-target can rebound directly toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Avoid direct roto-target shots. Use side hit lanes for the safer scoring route.

cautions.issue: An outlane scores a Home Run, but it still ends the ball unless another rule saves it.
cautions.response: Do not aim for an outlane. Treat a bases-loaded outlane award only as drain compensation.

playfieldReferences.label: Side hit lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Upper side lanes that score doubles or triples and feed the bumper area.

playfieldReferences.label: Base saucers
playfieldReferences.description: Three center saucers that place a runner on first, second, or third base.

playfieldReferences.label: Home Run standups
playfieldReferences.description: Outside upper standups that become 5,000-point Home Runs with the bases loaded.

playfieldReferences.label: Top roto-target
playfieldReferences.description: Upper rotating target that can award points or a hit result.

playfieldReferences.label: Home Run outlanes
playfieldReferences.description: Drain lanes that award a Home Run as compensation.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the Gottlieb two-flipper, three-saucer layout; do not use Bally Grand Slam rules with HOMER targets and an upper reversed flipper.
Confirm Grand Slam replay or World Series add-a-ball handling, ball count, tilt, and any tournament award conversion.
Test both side-lane feeds, all three saucers, the bases-loaded standups, roto-target rebound, and runner lamps before choosing a route.
input.simpleOverview: Grand Slam / World Series uses side Double and Triple lanes for repeatable upper-playfield scoring. Plunge the top Home Run lane, keep using the safer side lane, accept base saucers through natural play, then shoot an outside Single standup for a 5,000-point Home Run when the bases are loaded.
